extraction_text: When Section 2-A of this Article is invoked to fill a position of a new machine or assignment within an existing classification within a particular department, then employees within such classification within the department may request reassignment through their supervisor. Such reassignments will be based on seniority and qualifications.

Eligibility for Job Security Benefits will arise when: 1. An employee, with one (1) year or more of seniority, is reduced from his seniority classification as a result of the permanent discontinuance of work directly attributable to subcontracting or the introduction of new technology into the plant, or 2. An employee, with one (1) year or more of seniority, is reduced from his department as a direct result of 1. above.
